{"hypotheses": [
  {"name": "Hypothesis 1",
   "mechanism": "Firms with high R&D investment and positive recent earnings surprises (EP) are likely to outperform, especially when market sentiment is bullish.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "EarningsSurprise"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "EarningsSurprise", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": null
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis 2",
   "mechanism": "Companies with low leverage (Leverage) and high short interest (ShortInterest) are likely to outperform especially during bear markets due to potential short squeezes.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Leverage"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "ShortInterest"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 60
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis 3",
   "mechanism": "Firms with high asset growth (AssetGrowth) and low idiosyncratic risk (IdioVol3F) may outperform during periods of positive term spread due to increased investment efficiency.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "AssetGrowth"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "IdioVol3F"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "IdioVol3F", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 48
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis 4",
   "mechanism": "Firms with high advertising expense (AdExp) and low tangible assets (tang) may outperform, especially during bullish markets, due to brand value and innovation.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "AdExp"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "tang"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "AdExp", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.75,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 36
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis 5",
   "mechanism": "Companies with high gross profits (GP) and low bid-ask spread (BidAskSpread) are likely to outperform during periods of low market volatility due to efficient operations and high liquidity.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "GP"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "BidAskSpread"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "GP", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.65,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis 6",
   "mechanism": "Firms with high cash reserves (Cash) and low price (Price) will outperform especially in bearish markets due to financial stability and undervaluation.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Cash"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Price"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.85,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 72
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis 7",
   "mechanism": "Firms with high analyst optimism (AOP) and low return skewness (ReturnSkew) may outperform during periods of positive term spread due to market sentiment and symmetrical return distribution.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "AOP"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "ReturnSkew"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "AOP", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 60
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis 8",
   "mechanism": "Companies with high asset turnover (ChAssetTurnover) and low idiosyncratic volatility (IdioVolAHT) will outperform, especially in volatile markets, due to operational efficiency and lower risk.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "ChAssetTurnover"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "IdioVolAHT"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "ChAssetTurnover", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.75,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 18
  }
]}
